objects.name: gold_country_context
objects.comment: Country economic and governance context: one row per WDI economy (217; aggregates excluded) x calendar year 2000-2025 (5,642). WDI, WGI and CPIA values copied as published (no interpolation, imputation, normalisation or derived scores; unavailable = NULL). WB income groups are FISCAL-year classifications carried for both fiscal years overlapping the calendar year. Keyed strictly by published calendar year; join on the validated wdi_country_code (regional projects have no country context). Downstream join lags and ML feature policies are reviewed separately. All values are current-vintage estimates, not verified point-in-time observations and not historically available ML features

properties.delta.constraints.window_only_for_valid_: (published_response_window_days IS NULL AND deadline_after_source_snapshot IS NULL) OR (is_solicitation_notice AND published_response_window_days > 0 AND published_response_window_days = datediff(deadline_date_published, publication_date) AND deadline_status IN ('positive_window', 'positive_window_over_180_days_review'))

objects.name: vw_kpi_contract_awards
objects.comment: Additive contract-award cube. contract_fiscal_year = World Bank fiscal year FYn = 1 July (n-1) to 30 June n, as published in the Gold source (consistent with the source date by Gold CHECK constraint) of contract_signing_date. Shares: prior review = prior/(prior+post), unknown review excluded. other-country suppliers = other/(same+other), undetermined reported as unknown. Proposed D-23 KPI baseline: D-23 pending. Read-only aggregation of verified Gold tables, with no supplier, contact or free-text fields.

columns.name: contract_fiscal_year
columns.comment: WB fiscal year of signing as published (Jul-Jun; consistent with the signing date)

columns.name: geography_type
columns.comment: single_country | regional_multicountry (approved curated rule, identical to the cohort manifest flag)

columns.name: wdi_country_code
columns.comment: Projects validated WDI country code; NULL for regional projects. The only country key for reference joins

objects.view_definition:
SELECT contract_fiscal_year, region_name, geography_type, wdi_country_code,
       CASE WHEN geography_type = 'single_country' THEN project_country_name END AS country_name, procurement_category, procurement_method,
       count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd,
       count_if(review_type = 'Prior') AS prior_review_contracts, count_if(review_type = 'Post') AS post_review_contracts,
       count_if(review_type IS NULL) AS review_type_unknown_contracts, count_if(is_multi_supplier) AS multi_supplier_contracts,
       count_if(has_anonymized_individual_consultant) AS individual_consultant_contracts,
       count_if(supplier_country_relation = 'all_suppliers_same_country') AS same_country_supplier_contracts,
       count_if(supplier_country_relation = 'includes_other_country') AS other_country_supplier_contracts,
       count_if(supplier_country_relation = 'undetermined') AS supplier_country_undetermined_contracts,
       count_if(signed_before_board_approval) AS contracts_signed_before_board_approval,
       max(source_as_of_date) AS source_as_of_date, max(gold_run_id) AS source_gold_run_id
FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics
GROUP BY contract_fiscal_year, region_name, geography_type, wdi_country_code, CASE WHEN geography_type = 'single_country' THEN project_country_name END,
         procurement_category, procurement_method

objects.name: vw_kpi_contract_value_distribution
objects.comment: Contract-value distribution (discrete percentiles = actual contract values). grouping_level rows are SUBTOTALS of each other: always filter to ONE grouping_level. never sum across levels. contract_fiscal_year = World Bank fiscal year FYn = 1 July (n-1) to 30 June n, as published in the Gold source (consistent with the source date by Gold CHECK constraint). Proposed D-23 KPI baseline: D-23 pending. Read-only aggregation of verified Gold tables, with no supplier, contact or free-text fields.

columns.name: contract_fiscal_year
columns.comment: WB fiscal year of signing as published (Jul-Jun; consistent with the signing date)

objects.view_definition:
SELECT CASE grouping_id(contract_fiscal_year, procurement_category) WHEN 0 THEN 'fiscal_year_x_category' WHEN 1 THEN 'fiscal_year'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'category' ELSE 'all_contracts' END AS grouping_level,
       contract_fiscal_year, procurement_category, count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd,
       min(contract_amount_usd) AS min_contract_value_usd,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY contract_amount_usd) AS DECIMAL(32,2)) AS p25_contract_value_usd,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY contract_amount_usd) AS DECIMAL(32,2)) AS p50_contract_value_usd,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY contract_amount_usd) AS DECIMAL(32,2)) AS p75_contract_value_usd,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY contract_amount_usd) AS DECIMAL(32,2)) AS p90_contract_value_usd,
       max(contract_amount_usd) AS max_contract_value_usd, max(source_as_of_date) AS source_as_of_date, max(gold_run_id) AS source_gold_run_id
FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((contract_fiscal_year, procurement_category), (contract_fiscal_year), (procurement_category), ())

objects.name: vw_kpi_country_comparison
objects.comment: Per validated wdi_country_code (regional projects = one row, country NULL). each source aggregated separately then joined on a unique key. latest_income_group = CURRENT FY2026 World Bank income classification (OGHIST 2026-10-08), not a historical value. Proposed D-23 KPI baseline: D-23 pending. Read-only aggregation of verified Gold tables, with no supplier, contact or free-text fields.

columns.name: geography_type
columns.comment: single_country or regional_multicountry (from wbg_silver.projects)

columns.name: wdi_country_code
columns.comment: Validated WDI country code (wbg_silver.projects.wdi_country_code); NULL for regional projects

columns.name: country_iso3
columns.comment: WB 3-letter code (wdi_country.country_wb_id); join key to income_classification_history

columns.name: latest_income_fiscal_year
columns.comment: WB fiscal year starting 1 July of `year` (= year + 1)

columns.name: latest_income_group
columns.comment: WB income group for income_fy_starting_in_year (based on GNI per capita of year-1)

objects.view_definition:
WITH p AS (SELECT geography_type, wdi_country_code, count(*) AS projects FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_project_portfolio GROUP BY geography_type, wdi_country_code),
     c AS (SELECT geography_type, wdi_country_code, count(*) AS contract_awards, sum(contract_amount_usd) AS contract_award_value_usd
           FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics GROUP BY geography_type, wdi_country_code),
     n AS (SELECT geography_type, wdi_country_code, count(*) AS procurement_notices, count_if(is_tender_invitation) AS tender_invitation_notices,
                  count_if(is_tender_invitation AND deadline_status = 'positive_window') AS tender_invitations_with_positive_window
           FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_procurement_notices GROUP BY geography_type, wdi_country_code),
     f AS (SELECT geography_type, wdi_country_code, count_if(lender = 'IBRD') AS ibrd_loan_instruments, count_if(lender = 'IDA') AS ida_credit_instruments
           FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_financing_analytics GROUP BY geography_type, wdi_country_code),
     k AS (SELECT country_code, country_iso3, country_name, income_fy_starting_in_year AS latest_income_fiscal_year,
                  income_group_fy_starting_in_year AS latest_income_group FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_country_context WHERE year = 2025)
SELECT p.geography_type, p.wdi_country_code, k.country_iso3, k.country_name, k.latest_income_fiscal_year, k.latest_income_group, p.projects,
       coalesce(c.contract_awards, 0) AS contract_awards, c.contract_award_value_usd,
       coalesce(n.procurement_notices, 0) AS procurement_notices, coalesce(n.tender_invitation_notices, 0) AS tender_invitation_notices,
       coalesce(n.tender_invitations_with_positive_window, 0) AS tender_invitations_with_positive_window,
       coalesce(f.ibrd_loan_instruments, 0) AS ibrd_loan_instruments, coalesce(f.ida_credit_instruments, 0) AS ida_credit_instruments
FROM p
LEFT JOIN c ON p.geography_type = c.geography_type AND p.wdi_country_code <=> c.wdi_country_code
LEFT JOIN n ON p.geography_type = n.geography_type AND p.wdi_country_code <=> n.wdi_country_code
LEFT JOIN f ON p.geography_type = f.geography_type AND p.wdi_country_code <=> f.wdi_country_code
LEFT JOIN k ON p.wdi_country_code = k.country_code

objects.view_definition:

     c AS (SELECT count(*) AS contract_awards, count(DISTINCT wb_contract_number) AS distinct_contract_awards,
                  sum(contract_amount_usd) AS total_contract_award_value_usd, count(DISTINCT project_id) AS projects_with_contract_awards,
                  min(contract_signing_date) AS first_contract_signing_date, max(contract_signing_date) AS last_contract_signing_date,
                  max(source_as_of_date) AS contracts_source_as_of_date, max(gold_run_id) AS contracts_gold_run_id FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_contract_analytics),
     n AS (SELECT count(*) AS procurement_notices, count_if(notice_class = 'tender_invitation') AS tender_invitation_notices,
                  count_if(notice_class = 'prequalification_invitation') AS prequalification_notices,
                  count_if(notice_class = 'expression_of_interest') AS expression_of_interest_notices,
                  count_if(notice_class = 'contract_award_announcement') AS contract_award_announcement_notices,

objects.name: vw_kpi_response_windows
objects.comment: Published response windows for eligible solicitations (IFB, IFP, REOI) only. Statistics use positive windows of 1-180 days. the over-180-day outliers (96) are excluded from statistics and counted in over_180_day_review_notices (source records unchanged). Published windows, NOT verified tender durations. grouping_level rows are SUBTOTALS: filter to ONE grouping_level. publication_fiscal_year = World Bank fiscal year FYn = 1 July (n-1) to 30 June n, as published in the Gold source (consistent with the source date by Gold CHECK constraint). Proposed D-23 KPI baseline: D-23 pending. Read-only aggregation of verified Gold tables, with no supplier, contact or free-text fields.
objects.view_definition:
SELECT CASE grouping_id(notice_type, publication_fiscal_year, procurement_method) WHEN 0 THEN 'type_x_fiscal_year_x_method'
            WHEN 1 THEN 'type_x_fiscal_year' WHEN 2 THEN 'type_x_method' ELSE 'type' END AS grouping_level,
       notice_type, publication_fiscal_year, procurement_method,
       count(*) AS eligible_solicitation_notices, count_if(deadline_status = 'positive_window') AS positive_window_notices,
       count_if(deadline_status = 'positive_window_over_180_days_review') AS over_180_day_review_notices,
       count_if(deadline_status = 'equals_publication_date_no_window') AS no_window_notices,
       count_if(deadline_status = 'before_publication_date_invalid') AS invalid_window_notices, count_if(deadline_status = 'missing') AS missing_deadline_notices,
       min(CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'positive_window' THEN published_response_window_days END) AS min_window_days,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'positive_window' THEN published_response_window_days END) AS INT) AS p25_window_days,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'positive_window' THEN published_response_window_days END) AS INT) AS p50_window_days,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'positive_window' THEN published_response_window_days END) AS INT) AS p75_window_days,
       CAST(percentile_disc(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'positive_window' THEN published_response_window_days END) AS INT) AS p90_window_days,
       max(CASE WHEN deadline_status = 'positive_window' THEN published_response_window_days END) AS max_window_days,
       max(source_retrieved_at) AS source_retrieved_at, max(gold_run_id) AS source_gold_run_id
FROM workspace.wbg_gold.gold_procurement_notices
WHERE is_solicitation_notice
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((notice_type, publication_fiscal_year, procurement_method), (notice_type, publication_fiscal_year), (notice_type, procurement_method),

columns.name: transaction_key
columns.comment: Technical key project_id:transaction_index (source-array position); may change on an API refresh

columns.name: financier_loan

columns.name: amount_published

columns.name: identical_transaction_group_size
columns.comment: Rows in the project sharing every published field (>=1); not de-duplicated
